method.detail: Published method identity; implementation uses the declared shared-protocol adaptations.

model.detail: Shared Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, Qwen tokenizer, BGE-base-en-v1.5, seeds 42/123/2026; replaces original backbones.

tokenizer.detail: Shared Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, Qwen tokenizer, BGE-base-en-v1.5, seeds 42/123/2026; replaces original backbones.

retriever.detail: Hybrid BM25 plus dense RRF as in section 6.1; common BGE replaces all-mpnet-base-v2 for both passage and triple ranking.

top_k.detail: Appendix B.2: width 10, length 2, 100 neighbors per beam, gamma twice width (20), ten initial chunks per multistep round.

max_steps.detail: 256-step execution limit; method-specific step units are documented in agent_parameters.md. Reaching the limit returns an error.

seeds.detail: Shared Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, Qwen tokenizer, BGE-base-en-v1.5, seeds 42/123/2026; replaces original backbones.

beam_width.detail: Appendix B.2: width 10, length 2, 100 neighbors per beam, gamma twice width (20), ten initial chunks per multistep round.

beam_length.detail: Appendix B.2: width 10, length 2, 100 neighbors per beam, gamma twice width (20), ten initial chunks per multistep round.

neighbors_per_beam.detail: Appendix B.2: width 10, length 2, 100 neighbors per beam, gamma twice width (20), ten initial chunks per multistep round.

diversity_gamma.detail: Appendix B.2: width 10, length 2, 100 neighbors per beam, gamma twice width (20), ten initial chunks per multistep round.

triple_link_mode.detail: Hybrid BM25 plus dense RRF as in section 6.1; common BGE replaces all-mpnet-base-v2 for both passage and triple ranking.

answer_top_k.detail: Table 3 caption: downstream QA uses the top five retrieved passages. Appendix B.2 initial retrieval remains ten per multi-step round.

max_iterations_by_dataset.detail: Appendix B.1: two iterations for HotpotQA/2Wiki, four for MuSiQue.

encoder.detail: Shared Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, Qwen tokenizer, BGE-base-en-v1.5, seeds 42/123/2026; replaces original backbones.

rrf_k.detail: RRF uses constant 60; the GeAR paper specifies RRF but does not state its constant.
